notes: Preset selections approved by owner in recovered brief on 2026-10-25. Style strings preserved from v001; exact audition prompts and reference WAVs remain unavailable. Append characters; version existing definitions deliberately.

style.en: A cute, curious, cheerful little boy dinosaur in a children's adventure. Playful and innocent, expressive but not exaggerated, natural American English.
style.zh: A cute, curious little boy dinosaur. Natural clear Mandarin Chinese, playful and warm, youthful boyish voice.
style.ms: A cute, cheerful curious little boy dinosaur. Speak natural Malaysian Bahasa Melayu with Malaysian pronunciation and rhythm, not Indonesian or English-influenced. Slightly slower, clearly articulated without exaggeration.

style.en: Deep, warm, resonant masculine old gentleman voice of a wise magical Cloud Guardian. Calm, protective, powerful yet gentle, never frightening; natural American English.
style.zh: Deep warm masculine old gentleman voice of a wise, gentle Cloud Guardian; calm and protective. Natural Mandarin Chinese pronunciation.
style.ms: Deep warm masculine old gentleman voice of a wise and gentle Cloud Guardian. Natural Malaysian Bahasa Melayu, not Indonesian; slow, reassuring.

style.en: Sweet, gentle, warm feminine voice of a friendly magical Moon. Slightly youthful, soothing like a bedtime storyteller, softly grateful and joyful. Natural American English, never robotic.
style.zh: Sweet gentle feminine voice of a friendly magical Moon, soothing and grateful; natural Mandarin Chinese pronunciation.
style.ms: Sweet gentle feminine voice of a friendly magical Moon. Natural Malaysian Bahasa Melayu pronunciation, not Indonesian; clear, soothing and warm.

bunny.approval_basis: Owner approved keeping Leda and approved EP2 production plan; female Bunny, localized name 邦妮.

style.en: A sweet, youthful girl rabbit talking naturally to her friend Dino in a children's adventure. Warm, expressive, clear conversational English. Gentle and hopeful, with authentic relief or curiosity; never shrill, babyish, robotic or a narrator. Speak only the supplied words.
style.zh: 保持Leda年轻女孩的声线，邦妮是一只温柔活泼的小兔子。像小朋友自然地和朋友聊天，亲切、清楚，随求助、好奇、开心自然变化。不要尖细装嗲、播音腔、逐字朗读或夸张拖音。迪诺读dí nuò，邦妮读bāng nī。只说给定台词，不加旁白。
style.ms: A sweet youthful girl rabbit talking warmly and naturally to her friend Dino. Use natural Malaysian Bahasa Melayu pronunciation, vocabulary and rhythm, not Indonesian. Expressive hope, curiosity and relief without shrill cartoon delivery, baby talk or excessive pauses. Speak only the supplied dialogue.
